description.value:
Pure muscular force shapes your taijutsu. Your unarmed Strikes gain a +1 status bonus to damage rolls, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Powerful Fist] effect (treating fists as if you had the Powerful Fist class feature: unarmed Strikes deal lethal damage and the brawling-trait ability is bypassed).
